purpose: Implement the production-neutral Company OS F2A application boundary for control.процент-агро.рф: exact host realm, strict routing, host-only strict session credentials, parent-host staff cutover guards and control-aware auth flows without changing DNS, Caddy, Compose or production runtime.
requiredInvariants: The control realm is disabled by default and cannot become live solely by merging application code.
Only the exact canonical control host is recognized; X-Forwarded-Host, suffix matches, user-controlled role claims and office-network/IP location never establish control authority.

When the cutover gate is enabled, parent-host /platform-v7/staff redirects only to HTTPS on the canonical control host and parent-host /api/staff is fail-closed so the parent cannot remain an alternate privileged boundary.

When the gate is enabled, the control host serves only the bounded control/auth/static route set and never serves business cabinets, public registration, public assistant, demo or role-preview surfaces.
Successful login, membership selection and MFA on the control host land only at /platform-v7/staff; staff access is still authorized by server-side capabilities and current staff assignments.

Credential-bearing control-host cookies have no Domain attribute, are Secure in production, HttpOnly where credentials are stored, and use SameSite=Strict. CSRF remains readable only as required by the existing double-submit contract.
Control-host refresh and logout preserve strict session cookie behavior and correlation evidence.
The generic staff BFF and the capabilities BFF independently reject non-control hosts after cutover is enabled.
Existing JIT, SoD, MFA, access-session, capability, break-glass and staff endpoint policy authority is not weakened or duplicated.
No DNS, Caddy, Compose, production environment, secret, database schema or migration change is included in F2A.
Merge, CI and image build are not production deployment evidence.
acceptance: Exact-host parsing rejects ports with malformed values, commas, whitespace, suffix spoofing and X-Forwarded-Host-only spoofing.
With the gate disabled, current parent-host behavior remains unchanged.
With the gate enabled, parent staff pages redirect to HTTPS control host while parent staff APIs fail closed.
With the gate enabled, control host allows only login/recovery/staff/auth/staff API/static assets and blocks business/public/registration/demo paths.
Auth routes use control-aware strict session cookies and force the staff landing path in the control realm.
Staff BFFs fail closed when accessed through the parent or an unrelated host after cutover.
Focused tests prove no Domain attribute, strict SameSite control credentials, no office-network trust and no client-selected role authority.
Exact-head web unit, Node CI, security and relevant repository gates pass before merge.
No production mutation and no new recurring cost occur.
